explanation: Only active at D1, and high (about 9-10, a bit lower at 4-7 later in the episode) when the previous trial was a rare transition after choosing a2 (it landed in S1), whether or not it was rewarded; occasionally also high when the agent has been choosing a2 and then reaches S1 some other way. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after any common transition to S2 or any a1 rare trip to S2, and at D1 throughout long a1 runs (at most 2 there).
